title: cestrum amictum var. longifolium
intro: Cestrum amictum var. longifolium, commonly known as the long-leaved night-blooming jasmine, is a plant species within the family Solanaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and is traditionally used to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Cestrum amictum var. longifolium include its anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit analgesic, anti-inflammatory, and antispasmodic effects.
